description: Temporary, expiring acceptance for the two image-size build-only denial-of-service advisories in the Expo/Metro toolchain. A supported parent-graph repair exists but remains inside this app's seven-day release quarantine until 2026-08-28T13:24:45.109Z. These entries expire on the first UTC date after eligibility and must be removed with the dependency upgrade.

exceptions.title: image-size: ICNS parser allows denial of service through an infinite loop
exceptions.reachability: Build-machine availability exposure only, not device-reachable application code. The installed path is expo 57.0.13 -> @expo/metro 56.0.0 -> metro 0.84.4 -> image-size 1.2.1. Metro is the React Native bundler and does not ship in the bundle it emits. The application imports Expo runtime modules, noble cryptography, React, and React Native, but no source imports image-size or Metro, and this app has no image assets. A hostile ICNS file could hang a build job only if an attacker first introduced that file into the trusted source/build input boundary; it cannot be supplied through the paired mobile inbox or approval flow.

no_upstream_fix.npm_suggested_fix: supported parent-graph upgrade to @expo/metro@56.0.2 and metro@0.84.5
no_upstream_fix.how_checked: Registry metadata still shows image-size 2.0.2 as the latest direct release and every direct release remains inside the advisory range. The supported Expo graph repair is @expo/metro 56.0.2, which pins Metro 0.84.5; Metro 0.84.5 removes its image-size dependency and falls outside npm's vulnerable Metro ranges.
no_upstream_fix.why_suggested_fix_rejected: Not rejected permanently. @expo/metro 56.0.2 was published at 2026-08-21T13:24:45.109Z and is ineligible under apps/secure-app/.npmrc min-release-age=7 until 2026-08-28T13:24:45.109Z. Resolving it on 2026-08-25 would bypass the mobile boundary's supply-chain quarantine. This acceptance expires immediately after that quarantine clears.

exceptions.revisit_trigger: On or after 2026-08-28T13:24:45.109Z, update to the supported @expo/metro 56.0.2 graph, verify Metro 0.84.5 removed image-size, require a zero-high npm audit, and delete both exceptions. Revisit sooner if reachability, severity, affected packages, or package integrity changes.
